y0: The plank in your own eye
y1: Jesus said something interesting: 'Why do you see the speck in your brother's eye, but don't notice the plank in your own eye?'
y2: Before we judge others, we should look at our own mistakes.
y4: ‘Ask, and it will be given to you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.’
y5: ‘Is there a father who gives his child a stone when he asks for bread? Your heavenly Father gives even better things.’ And: ‘Whatever you desire for people to do to you, you shall also do to them.’
y6: The narrow gate and the good tree
y7: ‘Enter in by the narrow gate. The way that leads to life is narrow, and few are those who find it.’
y8: ‘A good tree produces good fruit.’ When we look at our words and actions, we can see what our heart is like.
y10: ‘Everyone who hears my words and does them is like a wise man who built his house on a rock. Even if it rains and the wind blows, the house won't fall.’
y11: ‘But everyone who hears my words and doesn't do them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand. That house will fall.’ The people were amazed at Jesus's teaching, because he taught with authority.
verse: “Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened for you.”
prayer: Jesus, help me to look at myself before judging others. Teach me to ask, seek, and knock when I pray to the heavenly Father. Let me not only hear your words, but do them, so I can be a wise person who builds their house on the rock. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: speck. A very small piece of dust or wood. The speck in your friend's eye.
d1: plank. A very large piece of wood that holds up the roof of a house. First remove the plank from your own eye.
d2: judge. To look for someone else's mistakes and speak badly about them. Do not judge.
d3: narrow gate. A small door that is hard to enter. It represents the path of following Jesus. Enter in by the narrow gate.
d4: fruit. What grows on a tree. A person's words and actions are also their fruit. A good tree produces good fruit.
d5: rock. A very large and solid stone. The house built on the rock won't fall.
d6: authority. The power and right that makes others obey. Jesus taught with authority.
